title: Vivacious Manipulations
subtitle: Animus — the animating force
text: Animus is the school of the living body: blood that moves, binds and grows. Blood Shot (QUICK) fires a condensed blood projectile. Guided Blood Shot (QUICK) steers toward the creature nearest your aim, Hematic Mortar (CHARGED) lobs one heavy shot in an arc, and Sanguine Halo (QUICK) hangs five shots round you that seek hostiles one at a time. Blood Rush (QUICK) quickens the body for eight seconds. Hematic Riposte (QUICK) throws a clawed blood-arm across your front and turns aside what strikes from ahead. Blood Cloud (QUICK) settles a wounding cloud that builds Sanguine Pressure; Expansive Blood Cloud (QUICK) spreads it wider, Pursuing Blood Cloud (QUICK) sends it after enemies, and Sanguine Tempest (QUICK) seeds a storm whose lightning strikes beneath it. Blood Aneurysm (CHARGED) ruptures the nearest hostile vessel and spends its Sanguine Pressure. Summon Avatar (PASSIVE) manifests the Blood Avatar round your body; Blood Avatar: Arms, Blood Avatar: Armor, Blood Avatar: Legs and Blood Avatar: Complete (all PASSIVE) build it out, form by form. Crimson Coronation (CHARGED) crowns you with retaliatory blood lances. Crimson Tithe (QUICK) is Hemorath's Canon Memory, woven from his Hallowed Residuum: borrow 500 mL against his hunger for thirty seconds, and repay double whatever you spend. Several Animus memories sculpt the verbs. Blood Binding (QUICK) binds one creature in place on R. Sculpting, Projection: hold it on a creature and it cannot move while blood flows, and it carries your Animus brand. Lingering Blood Binding (QUICK), Chain Blood Binding (QUICK) and Blood Lattice (QUICK) hold longer, run on into others, or spread through a pack; see Blood Binding. Vital Effusion (QUICK) stirs nearby plants on R. Sculpting, Projection: held on a plant, blood soaks its soil and it grows a step a second. Tendon Line (QUICK) throws a sinew line with Projection and hauls you along it with Absorption. Three have nothing to cast and work only through Projection: Blood Lash puts out the first strand, Living Land wakes ground to strike your enemies, and Venous Cling roots you to a wall or ceiling. Each has its own page. Conjure Blade reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Blade.
